sentences.en: But at the same time, there's still big disagreement over whether Trump is getting tough on China
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，关于特朗普是否以正确的方式对华强硬，

sentences.en: in the right way, whether he's actually being effective at changing the trade relationship with China.
sentences.zh: 以及他是否真的能有效改变与中国的贸易关系，仍存在巨大分歧。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Remember that Trump was imposing these tariffs as a way to get leverage for a better deal with
sentences.zh: 还记得特朗普当初加征这些关税，是为了换取与中国达成更好协议的筹码吗？

sentences.en: China?
sentences.zh: 中国？

sentences.en: Well, he gets a deal of sorts, actually, with the Chinese government, which includes some things about tariffs and also China agreeing to buy some products from the United States.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他确实与中国政府达成了一种协议，其中包括一些关于关税的内容，以及中国同意购买美国的一些产品。

sentences.en: Trump spins it as this huge win, but nobody else really, including Republicans, acts like
sentences.zh: 特朗普将其吹嘘为一场巨大的胜利，但实际上并没有其他人，包括共和党人，表现得好像

sentences.en: Trump has solved the problem that Trump himself has identified.
sentences.zh: 特朗普已经解决了特朗普本人所指出的那个问题。

sentences.en: This deal is not enough to make everybody go, well, everything's great with China now.
sentences.zh: 这份协议不足以让所有人觉得，嗯，现在一切与中国相关的问题都解决了。

sentences.en: We can move on to the next the next thing.
sentences.zh: 我们可以继续处理下一件事了。

sentences.en: China remains this huge issue.
sentences.zh: 中国依然是一个巨大的议题。

sentences.en: And the question of what is the most effective way to deal with them is still an animating force in politics.
sentences.zh: 而如何以最有效的方式应对中国，依然是政治中的核心驱动力。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: So politically huge win.
sentences.zh: 所以从政治上讲，这是一场巨大的胜利。

sentences.en: But policy wise and economically and fundamentally the problem of China still very much unresolved.
sentences.zh: 但在政策和经济层面，从根本上讲，中国问题依然远未解决。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是这样。

sentences.en: So then Biden comes in.
sentences.zh: 那么拜登上台了。

sentences.en: What does Biden do?
sentences.zh: 拜登做了什么？

sentences.en: Does he keep the tariffs on?
sentences.zh: 他保留了关税吗？

sentences.en: Biden comes to office and there remains this real pressure from economists to roll back what they consider to be the ineffective parts of Trump's trade policy.
sentences.zh: 拜登上任后，经济学家们依然施加了真正的压力，要求撤销他们认为特朗普贸易政策中无效的部分。

sentences.en: That includes many of the tariffs.
sentences.zh: 这包括许多关税。

sentences.en: And it's especially true at a time when almost immediately after Biden takes office, inflation spikes.
sentences.zh: 尤其是在拜登上任后几乎立即出现通胀飙升的情况下，更是如此。

sentences.en: And so Americans are paying a lot of money for products.
sentences.zh: 所以美国人正在为产品支付高昂的费用。

sentences.en: And there's this pressure on Biden, including from inside his administration, to roll back some of the China tariffs to give Americans some relief on prices.
sentences.zh: 拜登面临着压力，包括来自他政府内部的压力，要求撤销部分对华关税，以减轻美国人的价格负担。

sentences.en: And Biden considers this.
sentences.zh: 拜登考虑过这一点。

sentences.en: But he doesn't do it.
sentences.zh: 但他没有这样做。

sentences.en: He doesn't reverse Trump's tariff policy.
sentences.zh: 他没有推翻特朗普的关税政策。

sentences.en: In the end, he's actually building on it.
sentences.zh: 最终，他实际上是在此基础上进一步加码。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Wena Liu.
sentences.zh: 我是 Wena Liu。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我负责编写《纽约时报》游戏中的《Connections》谜题。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我热爱恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我还喜欢尝试捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky.
sentences.zh: 我是 Sam Mazursky。

sentences.en: And I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我每天负责创作《Spelling Bee》和《Letterboxd》游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做“联觉”的特质。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我在听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由像你们刚才听到的这些人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com/games 即可从今天开始游玩。

sentences.en: So, Jim, you said that Biden is actually building on Trump's anti-China policy.
sentences.zh: 那么，Jim，你说拜登实际上是在特朗普对华政策的基础上进一步加码。

sentences.en: What exactly does that look like?
sentences.zh: 这具体是什么意思？

sentences.en: So, Biden builds on the Trump-China policy in three key ways.
sentences.zh: 拜登在三个关键方面延续并加强了特朗普的对华政策。

sentences.en: But he does it with a really specific goal that I just want you to keep in mind as we talk about all of this.
sentences.zh: 但他这样做有一个非常明确的目标，在我们讨论这一切时，我希望你记住这一点。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Which is that Biden isn't just trying to beat China on everything.
sentences.zh: 那就是拜登不仅仅是想在所有事情上击败中国。

sentences.en: He's not trying to cut a better deal.
sentences.zh: 他不是为了达成更好的交易。

sentences.en: Biden is trying to beat China in a specific race to own the clean energy future.
sentences.zh: 拜登是想在拥有清洁能源未来的特定竞赛中击败中国。

sentences.en: Clean energy.
sentences.zh: 清洁能源。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So, keep that in mind.
sentences.zh: 所以，请记住这一点。

sentences.en: Clean energy.
sentences.zh: 清洁能源。

sentences.en: An animating force behind all of the things Biden does with China is that Biden wants to beat China on what he thinks are the jobs of the future.
sentences.zh: 拜登对华所有行动背后的驱动力，是他想在被他视为未来就业机会的领域击败中国。

sentences.en: And that's green technology.
sentences.zh: 那就是绿色技术。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So, what does he do first?
sentences.zh: 那么，他首先做了什么？

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Thing number one.
sentences.zh: 第一件事。

sentences.en: Let's talk about the tariffs.
sentences.zh: 我们来谈谈关税。

sentences.en: He does not roll them back.
sentences.zh: 他没有撤销它们。

sentences.en: And actually, he builds on them.
sentences.zh: 实际上，他还在加码。

sentences.en: For years, for the most part, he just lets the tariffs be.
sentences.zh: 多年来，在大多数情况下，他只是任由关税存在。

sentences.en: His administration reviews them.
sentences.zh: 他的政府对它们进行了审查。

sentences.en: And it's only now, this week, when his administration is going to actually act on the tariffs.
sentences.zh: 直到现在，也就是本周，他的政府才真正开始对关税采取行动。

sentences.en: And what they're going to do is raise some of them.
sentences.zh: 他们要做的是提高其中一些关税。

sentences.en: They're going to raise them on strategic green tech things, like electric vehicles, in order to make them more expensive.
sentences.zh: 他们将提高针对战略性绿色科技产品的关税，比如电动汽车，目的是让它们变得更贵。

sentences.en: And I think it's important to know the backdrop here, which is, since Biden has taken office, China has started flooding global markets with really low-cost green technologies.
sentences.zh: 我认为了解这里的背景很重要，那就是自拜登上任以来，中国开始向全球市场倾销成本极低的绿色技术产品。

sentences.en: Solar panels, electric vehicles are the two really big ones.
sentences.zh: 太阳能电池板和电动汽车是两个非常大的类别。

sentences.en: And Biden's aides are terrified that those imports are going to wash over the United States and basically wipe out American automakers, solar panel manufacturers,
sentences.zh: 拜登的助手们非常担心这些进口产品会涌入美国，基本上摧毁美国的汽车制造商和太阳能电池板制造商，

sentences.en: that essentially if Americans can just buy super cheap stuff from China, they're not going to buy it from American factories.
sentences.zh: 本质上，如果美国人能买到中国产的超廉价产品，他们就不会去买美国工厂生产的产品。

sentences.en: Those factories are going to go out of business.
sentences.zh: 那些工厂将会倒闭。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So Biden's goal of, you know, manufacturing jobs and clean energy, China is really threatening that by dumping all these products on the American market.
sentences.zh: 所以拜登关于制造业就业和清洁能源的目标，正受到中国向美国市场倾销所有这些产品的威胁。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: And so what he wants to do is protect those factories with tariffs.
sentences.zh: 所以他想做的是通过关税来保护这些工厂。

sentences.en: And that means increasing the tariffs that Trump put on electric vehicles in hopes that American consumers will find them too expensive to buy.
sentences.zh: 这意味着要提高特朗普对电动汽车加征的关税，希望美国消费者会觉得它们太贵而买不起。

sentences.en: But doesn't that go against Biden's goal of clean energy and things better for the environment?
sentences.zh: 但这难道不违背拜登关于清洁能源和环境友好型产品的目标吗？

sentences.en: I mean, you know, lots of mass market electric vehicles into the United States would seem to kind of advance that goal.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，大量大众市场的电动汽车进入美国似乎有助于实现这一目标。

sentences.en: And here he's saying, no, you can't come in.
sentences.zh: 而他在这里却说，不，你们不能进来。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Because Biden isn't just trying to reduce emissions at all costs, right?
sentences.zh: 因为拜登并不是不惜一切代价减少排放，对吧？

sentences.en: He wants to reduce emissions while boosting American manufacturing jobs.
sentences.zh: 他想在减少排放的同时，促进美国的制造业就业。

sentences.en: He doesn't want China to get a monopoly in these areas.
sentences.zh: 他不希望中国在这些领域获得垄断地位。

sentences.en: And he's also in particular worried about the politics of lost American manufacturing jobs.
sentences.zh: 而且他特别担心美国制造业岗位流失带来的政治影响。

sentences.en: So Biden does not want to just let you buy cheaper Chinese technologies, even if that means reducing emissions.
sentences.zh: 所以拜登不想仅仅让你买到更便宜的中国技术，即使这意味着减少排放。

sentences.en: He wants to boost American manufacturing of those things to compete with China, which brings us to our second thing that Biden has done.
sentences.zh: 他想促进美国在这些领域的制造业以与中国竞争，这就引出了拜登所做的第二件事。

sentences.en: OK.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: To build on Trump's China policy.
sentences.zh: 在特朗普对华政策的基础上进一步加码。

sentences.en: Which is that Biden has started to act like the Chinese government in particular areas by just showering American manufacturers with subsidies.
sentences.zh: 那就是拜登开始在特定领域表现得像中国政府一样，直接向美国制造商提供大量补贴。

sentences.en: I see.
sentences.zh: 我明白了。

sentences.en: So dumping government money into American businesses.
sentences.zh: 也就是向美国企业投入政府资金。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Tax incentives, direct grants.
sentences.zh: 税收激励、直接拨款。

sentences.en: This is a way that China has in the past decades built its manufacturing dominance is with state support for factories.
sentences.zh: 这是中国在过去几十年里建立制造业统治地位的方式，即通过国家支持工厂。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Biden is trying to do that in particular targeted industries, including electric vehicles, solar power, wind power, semiconductors.
sentences.zh: 拜登正试图在特定的目标行业中这样做，包括电动汽车、太阳能、风能、半导体。

sentences.en: Biden has passed a bunch of legislation that just showers those sectors with incentives and government support in hopes of growing up much faster American industry.
sentences.zh: 拜登通过了一系列立法，向这些行业注入了大量激励措施和政府支持，希望美国工业能更快地成长起来。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: So basically, Biden trying to beat China at its own game.
sentences.zh: 所以基本上，拜登是在试图以其人之道还治其人之身。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: He's essentially using tariffs to build a fortress right around American industry so that he can train the troops to fight the clean energy battle with China.
sentences.zh: 他本质上是在利用关税在美国家工业周围建立一座堡垒，这样他就可以训练军队与中国进行清洁能源之战。

sentences.en: And the troops being American companies.
sentences.zh: 而军队指的就是美国公司。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: It's like we're going to give them protection.
sentences.zh: 就像我们要给他们提供保护一样。

sentences.en: Protection is policy.
sentences.zh: 保护就是政策。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: In order to, you know, get up to size, get up to strength as an army in this battle for clean energy dominance against the Chinese.
sentences.zh: 为了让他们在与中国争夺清洁能源主导权的这场战斗中，成长到足够的规模和实力。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: So he's trying to build up the fortress.
sentences.zh: 所以他是在试图建立堡垒。

sentences.en: What's the third thing Biden does?
sentences.zh: 拜登做的第三件事是什么？

sentences.en: You mentioned three things.
sentences.zh: 你提到了三件事。

sentences.en: Biden does not want the United States going it alone against China.
sentences.zh: 拜登不希望美国在对抗中国时孤军奋战。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: He's trying to build an international coalition,
sentences.zh: 他正在努力建立一个国际联盟，

sentences.en: wealthy countries and some other emerging countries that are going to take on China and try to stop the Chinese from using their trade playbook to take over all these new emerging industrial markets.
sentences.zh: 包括富裕国家和其他一些新兴国家，共同对抗中国，试图阻止中国利用其贸易策略来接管所有这些新兴工业市场。

sentences.en: But, Jim, why?
sentences.zh: 但是，Jim，为什么？

sentences.en: Like, what does the U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国能从把盟友拉入这场贸易战中得到什么？

sentences.en: get from bringing our allies into this trade war?
sentences.zh: 美国为什么要这样做？

sentences.en: Why does the U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国为什么要那样做？

sentences.en: want that?
sentences.zh: 美国为什么要那样做？

sentences.en: Some of this really is about stopping China from gaining access to new markets.
sentences.zh: 其中一部分确实是为了阻止中国进入新市场。

sentences.en: It's like if you put the low cost Chinese exports on a boat and it's going around the world looking for a dock to stop and offload the stuff and sell it.
sentences.zh: 就像如果你把低成本的中国出口产品装上一艘船，它在世界各地寻找港口停靠、卸货并出售。

sentences.en: Biden wants barriers up at every possible port.
sentences.zh: 拜登希望在每一个可能的港口都竖起壁垒。

sentences.en: And he wants factories in those places that are competing with the Chinese.
sentences.zh: 并且他希望在这些地方有与中国竞争的工厂。

sentences.en: And a crucial fact to know here is that the United States and Europe, they are behind China when it comes to clean energy technology.
sentences.zh: 这里一个关键的事实是，美国和欧洲在清洁能源技术方面落后于中国。

sentences.en: The Chinese government has invested a lot more than America and Europe in building up its industrial capacity for clean energy.
sentences.zh: 中国政府在建立清洁能源工业能力方面的投资远超美国和欧洲。

sentences.en: So America and its allies want to deny China dominance of those markets and to build up their own access to them.
sentences.zh: 所以美国及其盟友想要否认中国在这些市场的主导地位，并建立他们自己进入这些市场的渠道。

sentences.en: And they're behind, so they got to get going.
sentences.zh: 而且他们落后了，所以他们必须行动起来。

sentences.en: It's like they're in a race and they're trailing.
sentences.zh: 就像他们在一场比赛中，而且处于落后位置。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's an economic race, right, to own these industries.
sentences.zh: 是的，这是一场经济竞赛，对吧，为了拥有这些产业。

sentences.en: And it's that global emissions race.
sentences.zh: 这也是一场全球减排竞赛。

sentences.en: They also want to be bringing down fossil fuel emissions faster than they currently are.
sentences.zh: 他们也希望比目前更快地减少化石燃料排放。

sentences.en: And this is their plan.
sentences.zh: 这就是他们的计划。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So I guess, Jim, the question in my mind is, Trump effectively broke the seal, right?
sentences.zh: 所以我猜，Jim，我心中的问题是，特朗普有效地打破了僵局，对吧？

sentences.en: He started all of these tariffs.
sentences.zh: 他开启了所有这些关税。

sentences.en: He started this trade war with China.
sentences.zh: 他发起了这场对华贸易战。

sentences.en: But he did it in this kind of jackhammer, non-targeted way.
sentences.zh: 但他采取的是那种大锤式、非针对性的方式。

sentences.en: And it didn't really work economically.
sentences.zh: 而且在经济上并没有真正奏效。

sentences.en: Now, Biden is taking it a step further.
sentences.zh: 现在，拜登正在更进一步。

sentences.en: But the question is, is his effort here going to work?
sentences.zh: 但问题是，他在这里的努力会奏效吗？

sentences.en: The answer to whether it's going to work really depends on what your goals are, right?
sentences.zh: 这事儿能不能成，其实取决于你的目标是什么，对吧？

sentences.en: And Biden and Trump have very different goals.
sentences.zh: 而拜登和特朗普的目标截然不同。

sentences.en: If Trump wins the White House back, he has made very clear that his goal is to try to rip the United States trade relationship with China even more than he already has.
sentences.zh: 如果特朗普重返白宫，他已经说得很清楚了，他的目标是试图比现在更彻底地切断美国与中国的贸易关系。

sentences.en: He just wants less trade with China and more stuff of all types made in the United States that used to be made in China.
sentences.zh: 他就是想要减少与中国的贸易，并让更多原本在中国生产的各类商品转而在美国制造。

sentences.en: That's a very difficult goal.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常艰巨的目标。

sentences.en: But it's not Biden's goal.
sentences.zh: 但这并不是拜登的目标。

sentences.en: Biden's goal is that he wants America to make more stuff in these targeted industries.
sentences.zh: 拜登的目标是希望美国能在这些重点行业中实现更多本土制造。

sentences.en: And there is real skepticism from free market economists that his industrial policies will work on that.
sentences.zh: 自由市场经济学家对此深表怀疑，认为他的产业政策能否奏效。

sentences.en: But there's a lot of enthusiasm for it from a new strain of Democratic economists in particular who believe that the only chance Biden has to make that work is by pulling all of these levers,
sentences.zh: 但新一代民主党经济学家对此却充满热情，他们特别相信，拜登要实现这一目标的唯一机会就是动用所有手段，

sentences.en: by doing the big subsidies and by putting up the tariffs, that you have to have both the troops training and the wall around them.
sentences.zh: 既要进行大规模补贴，又要加征关税，也就是说，你既要有训练有素的军队，也要有环绕四周的围墙。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And if it's going to work, he has to build on the Trump policies.
sentences.zh: 如果想让政策奏效，他必须在特朗普政策的基础上进行建设。

sentences.en: And so I guess you're asking, will it work?
sentences.zh: 所以我想你是在问，这行得通吗？

sentences.en: It may be dependent upon just how far he's willing to go on the subsidies and the barriers.
sentences.zh: 这可能取决于他在补贴和贸易壁垒上愿意走多远。

sentences.en: There's a chance of it.
sentences.zh: 是有可能的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So, Jim, at the highest level, you know, whatever the economic outcome here,
sentences.zh: 那么，吉姆，从宏观层面来看，无论最终的经济结果如何，

sentences.en: it strikes me that these moves by Biden are pretty remarkably different from the policies of the Democratic Party over the decades.
sentences.zh: 我发现拜登的这些举措与过去几十年来民主党的政策有着显著的不同。

sentences.en: I mean, really going in the opposite direction, right?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这简直是在背道而驰，对吧？

sentences.en: I mean, I'm thinking of Bill Clinton and NAFTA in the 1990s.
sentences.zh: 我想到了比尔·克林顿和上世纪90年代的《北美自由贸易协定》。

sentences.en: You know, free trade was the real central mantra of the Democratic Party, really of both parties.
sentences.zh: 你知道，自由贸易曾是民主党，甚至两党真正的核心准则。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And Biden is a real break from Clinton.
sentences.zh: 而拜登与克林顿的做法截然不同。

sentences.en: Clinton was the one who actually signed the law that really opened up trade with China.
sentences.zh: 正是克林顿签署了那项真正开启中美贸易往来的法律。

sentences.en: And Biden's a break from that.
sentences.zh: 而拜登正在打破这一传统。

sentences.en: He's a break from even President Obama when he was vice president.
sentences.zh: 他甚至打破了奥巴马总统时期（他担任副总统时）的政策。

sentences.en: Biden is doing something different.
sentences.zh: 拜登正在做一些不同的事情。

sentences.en: He's breaking from that Democratic tradition and he's building on what Trump did,
sentences.zh: 他正在脱离民主党的传统，并在特朗普所做工作的基础上进行建设，

sentences.en: but with some throwback elements to it from like the Roosevelt administration and the Eisenhower administration.
sentences.zh: 但其中又带有一些罗斯福和艾森豪威尔政府时期的复古元素。

sentences.en: This is this grand American tradition of industrial policy that gave us the space race and the interstate highway system.
sentences.zh: 这是一种伟大的美国产业政策传统，它曾带给我们太空竞赛和州际公路系统。

sentences.en: It's the idea of using the power of the federal government to build up specific industrial capacities.
sentences.zh: 其核心理念是利用联邦政府的力量来建立特定的工业能力。

sentences.en: It was in vogue for a time.
sentences.zh: 这种做法曾一度流行。

sentences.en: It fell out of fashion and was sort of replaced by this idea that the government should get out of the way and you let the free market drive innovation.
sentences.zh: 后来它不再时髦，取而代之的是一种观点，即政府应该放手，让自由市场去驱动创新。

sentences.en: And now that industrial policy idea is back in vogue and Biden is doing it.
sentences.zh: 而现在，这种产业政策的理念又流行起来了，拜登正在践行它。

sentences.en: So it isn't just a shift or an evolution.
sentences.zh: 所以这不仅仅是一个转变或演变。

sentences.en: It's actually a return to big government spending of the 30s and the 40s and the 50s of American industrialism of that era.
sentences.zh: 这实际上是回归到了30年代、40年代和50年代那种大政府支出和美国工业主义的时代。

sentences.en: So kind of what goes around comes around.
sentences.zh: 所以这算是一种轮回吧。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And it's a return to that older economic theory with new elements.
sentences.zh: 这是在回归旧有的经济理论，同时加入了新的要素。

sentences.en: And it's in part because of the almost jealousy that American policymakers have of China and the success that it's had building up its own industrial base.
sentences.zh: 这在一定程度上是因为美国决策者对中国及其在建立自身工业基础方面取得的成功感到近乎嫉妒。

sentences.en: But it's also has this political element to it.
sentences.zh: 但这也包含政治因素。

sentences.en: It's in part animated by the success that Trump had making China an issue with working class American voters.
sentences.zh: 这在一定程度上是受特朗普成功将中国问题转化为美国工薪阶层选民关注焦点的影响。

sentences.en: You didn't have to lose your job to China to feel like China was a stand in for the forces that have taken away good paying middle class jobs from American workers who expected those jobs to be there.
sentences.zh: 你并不一定要因为中国而丢掉工作，才会觉得中国是那些夺走美国工人高薪中产阶级职位的力量的代名词，尽管这些工人本以为这些职位会一直存在。

sentences.en: And so Trump tapped into that.
sentences.zh: 所以特朗普利用了这一点。

sentences.en: And Biden is trying to tap into that.
sentences.zh: 而拜登也正试图利用这一点。

sentences.en: And the political incentives are pushing every future American president to do more of that.
sentences.zh: 政治激励正在推动每一位未来的美国总统去做更多类似的事情。

sentences.en: So I think we are going to see even more of this going forward.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为未来我们会看到更多这样的举措。

sentences.en: And that's why we're in such an interesting moment right now.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我们正处于这样一个有趣的时刻。

sentences.en: So we're going to see more fortresses.
sentences.zh: 所以我们将看到更多的堡垒。

sentences.en: More fortresses, more troops, more money.
sentences.zh: 更多的堡垒，更多的军队，更多的资金。

sentences.en: Jim, thank you.
sentences.zh: 吉姆，谢谢你。

sentences.en: You're welcome.
sentences.zh: 不客气。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you should know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: Intense fighting between Hamas fighters and Israeli troops raged in parts of northern Gaza over the weekend, an area where Israel had declared Hamas defeated earlier in the war,
sentences.zh: 周末，哈马斯武装人员与以色列军队在加沙北部部分地区爆发了激烈战斗，而以色列在战争初期曾宣布该地区的哈马斯已被击败，

sentences.en: only to see the group reconstitute in the power vacuum that was left behind.
sentences.zh: 结果却看到该组织在留下的权力真空中重新集结。

sentences.en: The persistent lawlessness raised concerns about the future of Gaza among American officials.
sentences.zh: 这种持续的混乱状态引发了美国官员对加沙未来的担忧。

sentences.en: Secretary of State Antony Blinken said on Face the Nation on Sunday that the return of Hamas to the north left him concerned that Israeli victories there would be, quote,
sentences.zh: 美国国务卿安东尼·布林肯周日在《面对国家》节目中表示，哈马斯重返北部让他担心以色列在那里的胜利将是，引用他的话，

sentences.en: not sustainable, and said that Israel had not presented the United States with any plan for when the war ends.
sentences.zh: “不可持续的”，并称以色列尚未向美国提交任何关于战争何时结束的计划。

sentences.en: And the United Nations Aid Agency in Gaza said early on Sunday that about 300,000 people had fled from Rafah over the past week, the city in the enclave's southernmost tip,
sentences.zh: 联合国驻加沙援助机构周日早些时候表示，过去一周约有30万人逃离了拉法，这是该飞地最南端的城市，

sentences.en: where more than a million displaced Gazans had sought shelter from Israeli bombardments elsewhere.
sentences.zh: 此前有超过一百万流离失所的加沙人为了躲避以色列在其他地方的轰炸而在此寻求庇护。

sentences.en: The UN made the announcement hours after the Israeli government issued new evacuation orders in Rafah,
sentences.zh: 联合国是在以色列政府对拉法发布新的撤离令数小时后宣布这一消息的，

sentences.en: deepening fears that the Israeli military was preparing to invade the city despite international warnings.
sentences.zh: 这加剧了人们对以色列军队尽管受到国际警告仍准备入侵该市的担忧。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Nina Feldman, Carlos Prieto, Sidney Harper, and Luke Vanderplug.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由尼娜·费尔德曼、卡洛斯·普列托、西德尼·哈珀和卢克·范德普鲁格制作。

sentences.en: It was edited by M.J.
sentences.zh: 由M.J.戴维斯-林恩、布伦丹·克林肯伯格和丽莎·周编辑。

sentences.en: Davis-Lynn, Brendan Klinkenberg, and Lisa Chow.
sentences.zh: 包含黛安·王、玛丽安·洛萨诺和丹·鲍威尔的原创音乐。

sentences.en: Contains original music by Diane Wong, Marian Lozano, and Dan Powell.
sentences.zh: 由艾丽莎·莫克斯利进行工程制作。

sentences.en: And was engineered by Alyssa Moxley.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由Wonderly的吉姆·布伦伯格和本·兰兹维克创作。

sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.zh: 我是萨布丽娜·塔弗尼西。

sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.zh: 敬请收听，获取让客人宾至如归的小贴士。

sentences.zh: 他们是那种需要全黑环境才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是不是睡到不省人事。

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们对光线有什么要求？

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
